features.summary: Firefox added CSS Typed OM math operations such as `add()` and `min()`, along with support for setting multiple values through `StylePropertyMap`. It also added CSS features including `text-autospace-size` and `margin-trim`, and improved how animations, named timelines, and rendering-blocking resources are handled. These changes expand what websites can express and make existing styling behavior more consistent.
